## Executive Summary

Successfully implemented database-level text search and pagination for the Episodes page. All episode filtering now happens at the database query layer using Supabase `ilike` and `range()` instead of client-side filtering after a limited fetch. Pagination controls added to the UI with Previous/Next navigation.

1. **Pagination**: Navigate to Episodes page, verify Previous/Next buttons work
